reason: Components in motion consistently annotate `): JSX.Element` (MotionCreatorShell, MotionTemplateBrowser, MotionStartPanel, Button in primitives.tsx, PreviewToolButton in StageCanvas.tsx), and neither eslint.config.js (no explicit-function-return-type) nor tsconfig enforces it.
